events.title: Manchester Siti - Fulham
events.dataContent:
Manchester City vs Fulham: Live Stream & Watch Online

The Premier League title race heats up as reigning champions Manchester City host a resilient Fulham side at the Etihad Stadium. This mid-week fixture on Wednesday promises to be a captivating encounter, with City looking to maintain their dominant form and Fulham aiming to cause an upset and climb further away from the relegation zone. With both teams having distinct objectives for the remainder of the season, the tactical battle between Pep Guardiola and Marco Silva will undoubtedly be a fascinating spectacle for football fans worldwide. Kick-off: 11.02.2026, 19:30 UTC / 22:30 MSK
Stadium: Etihad Stadium
Competition: England - Premier League

Match Preview

Manchester City enter this match in formidable form, having firmly re-established themselves as genuine title contenders in recent weeks. Their attacking prowess, coupled with a newfound defensive stability, has seen them rack up a series of impressive victories. Pep Guardiola’s side will be eager to continue this momentum, especially in front of their home crowd, as they seek to exert pressure on their rivals at the top of the table. Fulham, under the astute management of Marco Silva, have shown flashes of brilliance this season. Despite a challenging run of fixtures, they have demonstrated a commendable spirit and an ability to score crucial goals. While facing City at the Etihad is arguably one of the toughest tests in the league, Fulham will take confidence from their counter-attacking potential and their capacity to frustrate bigger teams. Their ability to absorb pressure and hit on the break will be key to their chances of securing a positive result.

Team Form and Analysis

Manchester City

Manchester City's defense has been particularly solid recently, with Ruben Dias and John Stones forming a formidable partnership at the back. Their ability to swiftly transition from defense to attack is unparalleled, often spearheaded by the creative genius of Kevin De Bruyne and the clinical finishing of Erling Haaland. While there are no significant new injury concerns reported, Guardiola may opt for some rotation given the busy fixture schedule, but without compromising the team's balance. Key performers like Phil Foden and Bernardo Silva will be crucial in unlocking Fulham's defense.

Fulham

Fulham’s strength lies in their spirited midfield and the attacking threat posed by players like Andreas Pereira and Raúl Jiménez. Their defensive organization will be severely tested against City's relentless attack, and the performances of their central defenders will be paramount. João Palhinha’s presence in midfield will be vital for breaking up City’s play and winning possession. The Cottagers will likely adopt a compact defensive shape, looking to exploit any spaces left by City's advanced full-backs on the counter-attack. A strong performance from their goalkeeper will also be a prerequisite for any positive outcome.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Manchester City (4-3-3): - Ederson - Kyle Walker - Rúben Dias - John Stones - Joško Gvardiol - Rodri - Kevin De Bruyne - Bernardo Silva - Phil Foden - Erling Haaland - Jack Grealish Fulham (4-2-3-1): - Bernd Leno - Timothy Castagne - Tosin Adarabioyo - Calvin Bassey - Antonee Robinson - João Palhinha - Harrison Reed - Andreas Pereira - William Pacho - Bobby Decordova-Reid - Raúl Jiménez

Match Prediction

  • Main Prediction: Manchester City to Win by at least two goals. City's home form and superior individual quality are expected to overwhelm Fulham.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 3.5 Goals. Manchester City's potent attack often leads to high-scoring affairs, and Fulham have shown they can contribute to the scoreboard.

events.title: Athletic Club vs Real Sociedad
events.dataContent:
Athletic Club - Real Sociedad: Jonli efir va onlayn tomosha qilish

Fursatdan foydalanib, Basque derbisi Copa del Reyda 2026-yil 11-fevralda bo'lib o'tadi, Athletic Club Real Sociedadni chorak final uchrashuvida qabul qiladi. Ushbu mintaqaviy raqobat qizg'in kurashni va'da beradi, har ikkala jamoa ham yarim finalga chiqish uchun kurashadi. Athletic'ning himoyaviy mustahkamligi va La Real'ning hujumkor mahoratini hisobga olgan holda, bu uchrashuv futbol muxlislari uchun taktik mahorat va hayajonli tomosha bo'lishi kutilmoqda.Boshlanish vaqti: 11.02.2026, 20:00 UTC / 23:00 MSK
Stadion: San Mamés, Bilbao
Musoboqa: Ispaniya - Copa del Rey

O'yin haqida ma'lumot

San Mamés stadioni Ispaniya futbolidagi eng jo'shqin derbi uchun qizg'inlashadi. Athletic Club ushbu o'yinga ajoyib chidamlilik ko'rsatib kelmoqda, ayniqsa uy uchrashuvlarida o'z stadionini qal'aga aylantirgan. Ernesto Valverde qo'l ostida ular tezkor hujumlarga asoslangan kuchli himoya tuzilmasini ishlab chiqqanlar. Copa del Reydagi ularning safarlari qiyinchiliklarni yengib o'tishga bag'ishlangan. Uy muxlislarining energiyasi muhim omil bo'lib, sherlarni yangi cho'qqilarga olib chiqishi mumkin.Real Sociedad esa, aksincha, jozibali va hujumkor futbol bilan Bilbaoga keladi. Imanol Alguacil jamoasi La Liga yuqori pog'onalarida doimiy ishtirokchi bo'lib, kubok musobaqalarida o'z salohiyatini namoyish etgan. Ularning yarim himoyachisi Odegaard, Oyarzabal va Isak bilan birgalikda har qanday himoyani portlatishga qodir tahdid tug'diradi. Biroq, ularning so'nggi natijalari g'alaba qozonilgan o'yinlar va ba'zan duranglar bilan aralashgan, bu ularning raqiblari tomonidan ishlatilishi mumkin bo'lgan zaifliklarni ko'rsatadi. Ushbu kubok uchrashuvi har qanday jamoa uchun mavsumini boshlash va muxlislariga sovrin taqdim etish uchun ajoyib imkoniyatdir.

Jamoa shakli va tahlili

Athletic Club

Athletic Clubning kuchi ularning jamoaviy ruhi va himoyaviy tashkilotchiligida. Unai Simon darvozada ishonchli, Yeray Álvarez va Dani Vivian himoyasi esa ayniqsa mustahkam. Dani García va Vesga boshchiligidagi yarim himoya himoyachilar uchun muhim qalqon bo'lib xizmat qiladi hamda hujumlarni boshlaydi. Hujumda Nico Williamsning tezligi va aldamasi, Gorka Guruzeta'ning yakuniy zarbasi bilan birgalikda xavfli holat yaratadi. Iñigo Lekue'ning jarohatdan qaytishi qanotlarda qo'shimcha kuch berishi mumkin, Valverdega ko'proq taktik moslashuvchanlikni taqdim etadi. Ular uchun standart vaziyatlardan gol urish ham muhim yo'nalish bo'lib qolmoqda.

Real Sociedad

Real Sociedadning hujumkor qobiliyatlari shubhasiz, ular murakkab paslar va himoyani yorib o'tish qobiliyati bilan ajralib turadi. Martín Ødegaardning yarim himoyadagi ijodiy markazi ularning hujum ritmi uchun muhimdir. Mikel Oyarzabalning etakchilik va qanotlardan gol urish tahdidi, shuningdek Alexander Isakning havoda ustunligi va aniq zarbasi muhimdir. Biroq, himoyada ular vaqti-vaqti bilan zaifliklarni ko'rsatdilar, ayniqsa tezkor qarshi hujumlarga qarshi. Ular Athletic'ning to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yondashuviga qarshi intizomli bo'lishlari kerak. Muhim himoyachi Robin Le Normandning jismoniy holati Athletic'ning hujum chizig'ini nazorat qilishda hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega bo'ladi va uning ishtiroki o'yin natijasiga katta ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin.

Taxminiy boshlang'ich tarkiblar

  • Iñaki Williams
  • Gorka Guruzeta
Real Sociedad (4-3-3):
  • Álex Remiro (GK)
  • Hamari Traoré
  • Robin Le Normand
  • Pacheco
  • Kieran Tierney
  • Brais Méndez
  • Martín Zubimendi
  • Martín Ødegaard

  • Alexander Isak
  • Mikel Oyarzabal

O'yin bashorati

  • Asosiy bashorat: Athletic Club g'alaba qozonadi. Derbida San Mamés'dagi uy jamoasi ustunligi, shuningdek ularning so'nggi himoyaviy mustahkamligi Athletic'ga kichik ustunlik beradi.
  • Jami gollar bashorati: 2.5 dan kam gol. Kubok musobaqalaridagi derbi uchrashuvlari ko'pincha qiyin o'yinlar bo'ladi, har ikkala jamoa ham gol o'tkazmaslikka ustunlik beradi, bu esa kam sonli gollar bo'lishini taxmin qiladi.

events.title: Bologna - Lazio
events.dataContent:
Bologna - Lazio: Jonli efir va onlayn tomosha qilish

Oltin kubogi o'yinlari muhim bosqichlarga yetib kelganligi sababli, Bologna va Lazio qiziqarli o'yin uchun kurashishga tayyorlanmoqda. Ushbu yuqori martabali o'yin Seriya A ning ikki kuchli jamoasini keyingi bosqichga chiqish uchun kurashini ko'rsatadi, har ikki jamoa ham kubokdagi imkoniyatlarini namoyish etishga intiladi. Har ikki jamoaning so'nggi liga natijalari aralash ko'rsatkichlarni ko'rsatganligi sababli, bu pley-off o'yini yangi jang maydonini taklif etadi, bu erda taktikalar, individual mahorat va sof iroda hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega bo'lishi mumkin. Muxlislar bu mavsumda har bir klub kumush medalni ko'zlagani uchun qattiq kurashni kutishlari mumkin. Boshlanish vaqti: 11.02.2026, 20:00 UTC / 23:00 MSK
Stadion: Stadio Renato Dall'Ara
Musobaqa: Italiya - Oltin kubogi

O'yin haqida qisqacha ma'lumot

Bologna Oltin kubogi o'yinida Stadio Renato Dall'Ara stadionida Lazio bilan o'ynaydi. Thiago Mottaning dono rahbarligi ostidagi Rossoblu bu mavsumda ajoyib o'yinlar ko'rsatdi, ayniqsa uy stadionida ular ko'pincha o'zlaridan yuqori turgan jamoalarga qarshi kuchli o'ynashadi. Ularning intizomli mudofaa shakli va tezkor qarshi hujumlari ularni ko'plab yuqori saviyali raqiblar uchun jiddiy raqibga aylantirdi. Biroq, nomuvofiqlik tashvishga solmoqda, bu kubok o'yinini ularning chidamliligini haqiqiy sinoviga aylantiradi. Lazio esa, bu o'yinga kubokda chuqur yurish qilish maqsadida kirib keladi. Maurizio Sarri'ning Biancocelesti ko'pincha o'zining xos hujumkor futbolini namoyish etgan, ammo ular ham barcha musobaqalarda yuqori samaradorlikni saqlab qolishda qiynalgan. So'nggi natijalar jamoa hali ham o'z ritmini topayotganini ko'rsatmoqda va Oltin kubogidagi kuchli o'yin ligada yanada barqaror o'yin uchun turtki bo'lishi mumkin. Ayrim kichik jarohatlardan qaytayotgan asosiy o'yinchilar bilan Sarri bu qiyin safar o'yinida o'zining eng kuchli tarkibini maydonga tushirishga harakat qiladi.

Jamoa shakli va tahlili

Bologna

Bologna mudofaasining tashkil etilishi ularning mavsumining markaziy jihati bo'lib, o'rta darajadagi jamoa uchun kutilgandan kamroq gol o'tkazib yuborgan. Ularning hujumi, ko'pincha Riccardo Orsolini kabi o'yinchilarning individual mahorati yoki Joshua Zirkzee'ning mashaqqatli o'yinlariga bog'liq bo'lgan. Motta'ning taktik moslashuvchanligi ularga o'z yondashuvlarini moslashtirishga imkon beradi, ammo ular Lazio mudofaasini yorib o'tish uchun eng yaxshi natijalarga erishishlari kerak bo'ladi. Ayni paytda jiddiy yangi jarohatlar haqida xabar berilmagan bo'lsa-da, so'nggi liga jadvalining jismoniy talablari tanlovga ta'sir qilishi mumkin.

Lazio

Lazio'ning kuchi ularning yarim himoyadagi nazorati va Luis Alberto hamda Mattia Zaccagni kabi o'yinchilari yaratgan ijodiy oqimda joylashgan. Ciro Immobile ularning asosiy gol muammosi bo'lib qolmoqda va uning formasi gol oldidagi har qanday muvaffaqiyat uchun hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega bo'ladi. Sarri'ning 'Sarriball' falsafasi to'pni nazorat qilish va tezkor o'tishlarni ta'kidlaydi, ammo ular Bologna'ning qarshi hujumlariga ehtiyot bo'lishlari kerak. Mudofaa o'yinchilarining bir nechta kichik jarohatlari haqidagi yangiliklar diqqat bilan kuzatiladi, ammo Lazio'ning keng joylardan gol urish imkoniyatlarini yaratish va to'pni nazorat qilishga qaratilgan kuchli tarkibni maydonga tushirishi kutilmoqda.

Taxminiy boshlang'ich tarkiblar

Bologna (4-2-3-1):
  • Skorupski
  • Posch, Lucumi, Calafiori, Lykogiannis
  • Freuler, Moro
  • Orsolini, Ferguson, Saelemaekers
  • Zirkzee
Lazio (4-3-3):
  • Provedel
  • Lazzari, Romagnoli, Casale, Hysaj
  • Luis Alberto, Cataldi, Vecino
  • Felipe Anderson, Immobile, Zaccagni

O'yin bashorati

  • Asosiy bashorat: Lazio g'alaba qozonadi
  • Sabab: Bologna'ning kuchli uy rekordi mavjud bo'lishiga qaramay, Lazio'ning yuqori sifatli tarkibi va individual sifati, ayniqsa hujumda, ularni g'alaba qozonishiga olib keladi.
  • Jami gol bashorati: 2.5 ta gol ostida
  • Sabab: Har ikki jamoa ham kuchli mudofaaga ega va kubok o'yinlari ko'pincha ehtiyotkorona boshlanadi, bu esa kam sonli gol imkoniyatlari bilan qiyin o'yinni ko'rsatadi.

events.title: Sunderland - Liverpool
events.dataContent:
Sunderland vs Liverpool: Live Stream & Watch Online

The Stadium of Light prepares for a titanic Premier League encounter as Sunderland host title hopefuls Liverpool. This mid-week fixture on Matchday 25 carries significant weight for both sides: Sunderland will be fighting tooth and nail to secure vital points in their bid for survival or European qualification, while Liverpool aims to solidify their position at the top or maintain pressure on their rivals in a fiercely contested title race. With contrasting ambitions but equally high stakes, this promises to be a captivating battle of wits and skill under the floodlights. Kick-off: 11.02.2026, 20:15 UTC / 23:15 MSK
Stadium: Stadium of Light
Competition: England - Premier League

Match Preview

Sunderland enters this crucial fixture following a mixed run of form that has seen them pick up valuable points against mid-table teams but struggle against the league's elite. Their manager has emphasized tactical discipline and exploiting set-piece opportunities, given Liverpool's formidable defense. The Black Cats will be leaning heavily on their home support to create an intimidating atmosphere, hoping to rattle Jurgen Klopp's well-drilled machine. Recent injury concerns for key offensive players could force a reshuffle in their attacking approach, likely favoring a more counter-attacking style. Liverpool, meanwhile, arrives in Sunderland having showcased their customary attacking prowess and defensive solidity in recent weeks. While they've had a few blips on the road this season, their overall consistency has been remarkable. Klopp will be demanding a professional performance to avoid any complacency against a team battling for their lives. The squad depth at Anfield allows for rotation, keeping key players fresh, a significant advantage as the season enters its business end. However, a physically demanding schedule and a couple of minor injury scares in their last outing might influence Klopp's starting eleven.

Team Form and Analysis

Sunderland

Sunderland's defense has shown moments of resilience, particularly when playing deep and compact, but has occasionally been susceptible to pace and intricate passing movements. Their attack often thrives on the directness of their wingers and the aerial prowess of their center-forward. The team will be buoyed by the return of their influential central midfielder from suspension, providing much-needed creativity and control in the engine room. Key performer to watch is their lead striker, whose ability to hold up the ball and link play will be crucial against Liverpool's high defensive line.

Liverpool

Liverpool's defense, marshaled by their world-class center-backs, remains one of the league's strongest, capable of stifling even the most potent attacks. Their attack, spearheaded by a dynamic front three and supported by surging full-backs, is relentlessly potent, with goals coming from various sources. Klopp might opt for a slightly altered midfield to combat Sunderland's expected physical approach, potentially bringing in a more defensive-minded player. The form of their attacking midfielder has been exceptional, providing both goals and assists, making him a central figure in their creative efforts.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Sunderland (4-2-3-1):
  • GK: Patterson
  • DF: Hume, Ballard, O'Nien, Alese
  • MF: Ekwah, Neil
  • AM: Roberts, Bellingham, Clarke
  • FW: Burstow
Liverpool (4-3-3):
  • GK: Alisson
  • DF: Alexander-Arnold, Konate, Van Dijk, Robertson
  • MF: Szoboszlai, Endo, Mac Allister
  • FW: Salah, Nunez, Diaz

Match Prediction

  • Main Prediction: Liverpool to Win
  • Reasoning: Liverpool's superior quality, squad depth, and current form make them strong favorites against a resilient but outmatched Sunderland side.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals
  • Reasoning: Liverpool's potent attack is expected to find the net multiple times, and Sunderland, playing at home, will push for a goal, potentially opening up the game.
